theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_crt_pi_rows
theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (R : ι → Type) [∀ i, CommRing (R i)], let P := fun (A : Type) [CommRing A] => Quot (fun v w : {v : A × A // ∃ x y : A, x * v.1 + y * v.2 = 1} => ∃ u : Aˣ, (u : A) * v.1.1 = w.1.1 ∧ (u : A) * v.1.2 = w.1.2); Nonempty (P (∀ i, R i) ≃ (∀ i, P (R i)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
